verses.text: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I was sent to help God's chosen people to believe, and to know the truth that leads to living for God.
This faith and knowledge rest on the hope of life that lasts for ever. God, who never lies, promised this life before time began.
And at the right time he made his message known through the preaching he trusted me with, by the command of God our Saviour.
To Titus, my true son in the faith we share. Grace, mercy and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
I left you in Crete so that you could put in order what was still not done, and appoint church leaders in every town, as I told you.
A leader must be someone no one can find fault with. He must have only one wife. His children must be believers, and no one must be able to accuse them of wild living or of not obeying.

A church leader takes care of God's work, so he must be someone no one can find fault with. He must not be proud or quick to get angry. He must not drink too much, or be violent, or chase after money in dishonest ways.
Instead, he must welcome guests into his home and love what is good. He must think clearly, be fair and holy, and control himself.
He must hold firmly to the message we can trust, as it was taught. Then he can encourage others with healthy teaching, and show those who oppose it where they are wrong.
For there are many people who refuse to obey. They talk nonsense and fool others, most of all those who insist on circumcision.
They must be stopped from talking. They are upsetting whole families by teaching things they should not teach, just to make money in a shameful way.
Even one of their own prophets said, "People from Crete are always liars, evil animals and lazy people who eat too much."
What he said is true. So correct them strongly, so that they will be healthy in the faith.
Then they will stop listening to Jewish myths and to the commands of people who turn away from the truth.
To those who are pure, everything is pure. But to those who are unclean and do not believe, nothing is pure. Both their minds and their consciences are unclean.
They say they know God, but what they do shows that they deny him. They are hateful and disobedient, and no use for any good work.
